name: refly
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：refly。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Base skill for Refly ecosystem: creates, discovers, and runs domain-specific skills bound to workflows. Routes user intent to matching domain skills via symlinks, delegates execution to Refly backend. Use when user asks to: create skills, run workflows, automate multi-step tasks, or manage pipelines. Triggers: refly, skill, workflow, run skill, create skill, automation, pipeline. Requires: @refly/
